name: Kontant
description: Kontant is the consumer magazine, which every week addresses important issues that affect Danes and their wallets. The editors focus on the consumers' agenda, follow their complaints, come up with good advice, investigate and provide an overview.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tenants are being squeezed out by speculators who buy up a string of properties to score a quick profit. Electricity, water and heating are shut off, and when tenants complain, they risk being threatened. Jacob Kragelund goes in search of the network's backers and discovers that a previously convicted speculator from the financial crisis is haunting behind the scenes.
